Order No.07 Dated : 19.06.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Bhageet Besra @ Bhagit Besra is in custody since 16.10.2022 in connection with Gumla P.S. Case No. 316 of 2022 for the offence registered under Sections 376(2)(f), 376(2)(i) of the I.P.C. and Sections 4 & 6 of POCSO Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge IV cum Special Judge (POCSO), Gumla.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge IV cum Special Judge (POCSO), Gumla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, the petitioner was teacher and the victim was student who used to get her tuition classes from him.
It is alleged that he committed rape with her on several occasion.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that as per the FIR he started molesting the victim since 16.09.2017 whereas the case has been lodged after inordinate delay of about five years without any plausible explanation for the delay.
Section 376(2)(i) of the I.P.C. has already been deleted from statute but it has been wrongly applied in the present case.
Learned A.P.P. assisted by learned counsel on behalf of informant have opposed the prayer for bail.
It is submitted that the incidence started in 2017 in the form of molestation and culminated in the commission of rape in 2019 thereafter, the case was lodged in 2022.
The delay in lodging the case was understandable as victim was minor and she did not disclose the incidence immediately after the incidence out of fear and stigma.
It is submitted that the trial is in progress and the victim girl has fully supported the case.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the prayer for bail of the petitioner, is hereby,
rejected.
